hero.title: Forecast-ranked cross-asset portfolio.
hero.copy: F2R uses point-in-time own-price history across conventional machine-learning models and pretrained time-series intelligence. Their forecasts enter a common cross-asset ranking process before the monthly model portfolio is formed. The official portfolio and intramonth preview are shown separately.

current.title: Current model portfolio and intramonth preview
current.preview_note: Provisional current-month model estimate; it may change before month-end.

performance.title: Performance & risk
performance.record_boundary: This standalone dashboard uses F2R's completed current-model history from 2017-05 onward. PDS may show a longer current-definition reconstruction of F2R for cross-system comparison; that is a separate research series and does not replace this standalone F2R record.
performance.comparison_note: The equal-weight 11-asset universe and SPY / AGG 60/40 are reference comparators only; F2R is not managed as a benchmark-relative mandate.

history.title: Portfolio history
history.state_note: Completed target history + current Official + clearly labeled Preview
history.boundary_template: Historical rows contain the target portfolios used to reproduce completed performance through {completed_end}, including the opening target needed for the first execution transition. Current Official and provisional Preview are shown in the same fixed 11-ETF matrix; neither is included in completed performance.
history.signal_note: Signal month identifies the model decision; Holding month is the associated next-month target. Execution date is the first-next common close. The current open holding month and Preview are not part of completed performance history.
history.excel_note: The workbook matches the on-screen 11-ETF matrix. Preview is provisional and excluded from completed performance.

system.title: Architecture and operating boundary
system.forecasting_note: Conventional machine learning plus pretrained time-series intelligence.
system.accounting_note: Timing, turnover, transaction costs and accounting preserve model-portfolio validity; this is not brokerage-account reporting.
system.architecture_note: F2R combines conventional machine-learning forecasts with pretrained time-series intelligence at the cross-sectional ranking layer before portfolio selection.
system.historical_disclosure: Historical results apply the current F2R specification consistently across the available standalone history; any longer PDS reconstruction is a separate cross-system research series.
